-- L01 Datapoints previous only (script lines 110-111)
-- A company-year in the previous extract that is not in the current extract.
-- Returns the unexpected rows. {batch} is the table that holds both extracts, one row per company, year and snapshot.
SELECT p.record_key,
       p.organization_perm_id,
       p.year
FROM {batch} AS p
WHERE p.snapshot = 'previous'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM {batch} AS c
        WHERE c.snapshot = 'current'
          AND c.organization_perm_id = p.organization_perm_id
          AND c.year = p.year
      )

-- Same company and year in both extracts; the change is above max_pct_change % or below min_pct_change %,

       c.organization_perm_id,
       c.year,

       p.co2_emiss_scope1                                                  AS previous_value,
       c.co2_emiss_scope1 - p.co2_emiss_scope1                                    AS nominal_change,
       (c.co2_emiss_scope1 - p.co2_emiss_scope1) * 100.0 / NULLIF(p.co2_emiss_scope1, 0) AS pct_change
FROM {batch} AS c

  ON  p.organization_perm_id = c.organization_perm_id
  AND p.year = c.year
  AND p.snapshot = 'previous'

  AND (   (c.co2_emiss_scope1 - p.co2_emiss_scope1) * 100.0 / NULLIF(p.co2_emiss_scope1, 0) > 200
       OR (c.co2_emiss_scope1 - p.co2_emiss_scope1) * 100.0 / NULLIF(p.co2_emiss_scope1, 0) < -66)

kwargs.unexpected_rows_query:
-- L03 YoY Outliers (script lines 146-169), for one measure
-- In the current extract, the change from the same company's row before (by year) is above max_pct_change % or
-- below min_pct_change %, and bigger than min_abs_change. LAG works in SQLite, Spark SQL and SQL Server.
WITH ordered AS (
    SELECT record_key,
           organization_perm_id,
           year,
           co2_emiss_scope1                                                                 AS value,
           LAG(co2_emiss_scope1) OVER (PARTITION BY organization_perm_id ORDER BY year)     AS value_year_before
    FROM {batch}
    WHERE snapshot = 'current'
),
changes AS (
    SELECT record_key,
           organization_perm_id,
           year,
           value,
           value_year_before,
           value - value_year_before                                       AS nominal_change,
           (value - value_year_before) * 100.0 / NULLIF(value_year_before, 0) AS pct_change
    FROM ordered
)
SELECT record_key, organization_perm_id, year, value, value_year_before, nominal_change, pct_change
FROM changes
WHERE ABS(nominal_change) > 100000
  AND (pct_change > 500 OR pct_change < -83)
  AND pct_change <> -100
